_notes: bagCapacityPerPlayer: each player's bag holds 100 weight units (matches the CSV's Weight column directly, no conversion needed).
minPlayers: the CSV does not label a player requirement. Confirmed by the user (in-game) that this room is called 'Crisp Gallery', not 'Second Exhibit' — floor renamed accordingly.

value: NOT in the CSV. Secondary loot values are randomized per scope-out in-game, so this field is intentionally left null — the app should keep collecting it as a per-run user input, keyed to itemId.

BAY (Delivery Truck Crate) is the one exception: its true value can't be known until it's actually taken during the heist, so the UI renders it as a checkbox instead of a number input, driven by valueType/fixedValue below — checked locks its value to fixedValue, unchecked excludes it entirely, even if also marked Buyer's Choice. fixedValue was $122,500 (the $105k-140k community range, averaged) until 2026-08-03, when the user reported the truck's real value running lower than that average in practice; it's now a deliberately pessimistic $110,000 for optimizer math, and (unlike the averaged figure before it) is intentionally never surfaced as a dollar amount on index.html — see internal/model-notes.md.

scopeNote: reminder-only metadata (2026-08-03), currently only on BAY — rendered on index.html under the item's name whenever present. Warns that the item isn't guaranteed to be scoutable/present at all (the truck doesn't always spawn), distinct from requiresPreps above (which warns about needing a prep mission, not about the item's existence being conditional).

requiresPreps: reminder-only metadata (2026-07-26) for four items that need the Glass Cutter prep to actually be lootable in-game (0-A, 2-B, 2-C, 2-K). No eligibility gating or optimizer behavior is wired off this field yet — guide.html just warns if any of these end up packed. Full gating (a toggle, state.activePreps, excluding these from the optimizer when the prep isn't active) is deferred to a future 'specify your preps' system; see internal/model-notes.md's 'Glass cutter item gating' section for that design.

variants/variantLabel: optional cosmetic sub-type picker (2026-08-04), currently only on 2-H (Gemstone) — the gem that spawns in the Crisp Gallery varies per run, and the crew wants the guide to name it. Purely descriptive: the selection is NOT an eligibility, weight, value, or packing input, it just rides along in saved state and gets displayed next to the item name. Any catalog item can grow a `variants` array and get the same dropdown on index.html with no JS changes.

description: rudimentary 2-4 word tag (2026-07-31) added to help players unfamiliar with the heist recognize what they're grabbing — sourced from the user's living spreadsheet at internal/secondary-loot.json.csv (gitignored, not shipped) and merged in here by itemId on request. Rendered always-visible inline next to the item name on both index.html and guide.html — see internal/requirements.md for the disclosure-vs-inline UI decision.
